Klasse TestLifeCycleBeanProvider

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.di.impl.providers.TestLifeCycleBeanProvider
public class TestLifeCycleBeanProvider extends Object
Test class for LifeCycleBeanProvider. The basic functionality of this abstract base class is tested.
